snippet.title: Tower Lab - Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084810/Tower_Lab/

Tower Lab is a roguelike tower defense game where you have to push the enemies off the level. Every projectile and enemy is a physics object to be manipulated. Discover new towers. Unlock powerful upgrades. Build one-of-a-kind defenses.

As we get closer to the Steam demo launch, we will be focusing on getting the last few major systems into the game, focusing on game feel and improving the aesthetics, and expanding on the playable content. 

#gamedev #indiegame #games #towerlab
